create_L1Loss: create an L1Loss instance to compute mean absolute error between predictions and ground truth with optional max_gtnorm filtering
create_LaplacianLoss: create a LaplacianLoss instance to compute confidence-weighted L1 loss using exponential confidence parametrization for stereo estimation
create_LaplacianLossBounded: create a LaplacianLossBounded instance to compute confidence-weighted loss with sigmoid-bounded confidence for optical flow estimation
compute_StereoMetrics: compute stereo batch metrics including avgerr, rmse, and bad pixel percentages at thresholds 0.5, 1, 2, and 3
aggregate_FlowDatasetMetrics: aggregate optical flow dataset metrics across batches tracking L1 error, EPE, bad pixels, and speed-binned EPE then retrieve results
